cl_label: CD16-negative, CD56-bright natural killer cell, human
pr_label: MHC class II histocompatibility antigen alpha chain DRA
what_definition_sources_say_about_hla_dr: PMID:19796267 (Verneris MR et al. 2009, PMC2770803): HLA-DR not mentioned in the full text. PMID:22343568 (Maecker HT et al. 2012, PMC3409649): mentions HLA-DR on NK cells only as an activation marker: "The similar use of HLA-DR to track activated NK cells is a possibility that has been less well explored, but that might be equally fruitful." Neither source states that NK cells lack HLA-DR.
evidence_against_quote: We have observed that HLA-DR expression in freshly isolated circulating NK cells was mostly associated with less differentiated CD56brightCD57− cells, although in some individuals it could also be found in terminally differentiated CD57+ cells.
evidence_for_quote: In contrast, only 2–5.5% (median 3.5%) of fresh NK cells ex vivo expressed HLA-DR
proposed_action: Remove (or disable) the 'lacks_plasma_membrane_part HLA-DRA' axiom until a source is found (Dr. Diehl, 2026-10-05). HLA-DR+ cells are a minority but are concentrated in this subset.
